summary: IBC insolvency proceedings; appellant's claim as financial creditor vs operational creditor; statutory charge under UP Industrial Area Development Act; secured creditor status; COC membership eligibility; resolution plan approval validity; procedural defects in claim submission; NCLT/NCLAT dismissal upheld; appellant failed to timely challenge RP's classification; claim submission after process completion barred.
legal_provisions_cited: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 s.3(30), s.3(31), s.13, s.14, s.30(2)
U.P. Industrial Area Development Act, 1976 s.3, s.13, s.13A
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; NCLAT judgment affirming NCLT order upheld; appellant's claims as financial/secured creditor rejected; classification as operational creditor sustained.
